market_name: Will 10 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check 2y/10y Treasury yields and Fed funds futures (SOFR strip) for confirming downward move alongside any market probability shift.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move vs move in the prediction-market implied cut count; verify no offsetting inflation/supply headline.
time_plan.2h: Re-assess whether the shift is a broad risk-off (equities down, gold up) or an isolated rates story.
time_plan.6h: Look for Fed-speak, macro data, or news explaining the repricing; fade if no fundamental catalyst appears.
time_plan.12h: Evaluate whether the rate-cut repricing persisted into the next session; close research note with realized TLT return vs expectation.

predictions.reasoning: A market pricing 10 rate cuts (250bps) in 2026 implies expectations of an aggressive easing cycle, likely driven by recession or crisis. A sharp rise in that implied probability would signal falling front-end and belly rates, which pushes long-duration Treasury prices up. TLT is the cleanest liquid proxy for a duration rally.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check DXY and EUR/USD, JPY for confirming dollar softness vs safe-haven strength.
time_plan.1h: Determine if repricing is 'growth scare' (USD safe-haven up) vs 'dovish Fed' (USD down); adjust conviction.
time_plan.2h: Cross-check gold and front-end rates to disambiguate the driver.
time_plan.6h: Look for macro catalysts; reassess whether dollar direction is holding.
time_plan.12h: Record realized UUP move and whether the rate-cut narrative dominated the flight-to-safety narrative.

predictions.reasoning: Deep expected Fed easing (10 cuts) narrows US rate differentials and typically weakens the dollar, all else equal. A sharp rise in the implied cut count would pressure USD lower via lower expected yields. UUP is a liquid DXY proxy. However, in a genuine crisis scenario the dollar can rally on safe-haven flows, so direction is uncertain.

evidence_used: Market question implies an extreme easing scenario (10 cuts = ~250bps in 2026)
Standard macro linkage: aggressive Fed cuts -> lower yields -> higher bond prices, weaker USD
Resolution mechanics counting emergency inter-meeting cuts point to crisis/recession tail
uncertainty_notes: 10 cuts is a deep tail scenario; a probability move alone may not translate into any measurable 12h asset move
In a genuine crisis, USD and Treasuries both rally as safe havens, complicating the dollar call
This is a 2026 horizon market; near-term 12h asset moves are only loosely connected

llm_justification.summary: The market on 10 Fed cuts in 2026 is a proxy for an extreme aggressive-easing/recession scenario. A sharp increase in its implied probability would be consistent with expectations of much lower US rates, favoring long-duration Treasuries (TLT up) and a weaker dollar (UUP down). Both linkages are directionally sensible but modest over a 12h window and far below the 700bps tradable threshold; conviction is limited and the dollar direction is genuinely ambiguous in a crisis.
key_assumptions: A move in this market reflects a real shift in Fed easing expectations, not noise or thin liquidity
Lower expected policy rates transmit to lower Treasury yields within the window
No dominant offsetting catalyst (inflation surprise, Treasury supply, crisis safe-haven dollar bid)
failure_modes: The extreme 10-cut strike is so far out-of-the-money that probability changes carry no informational value for near-term assets
Crisis-driven easing expectations trigger safe-haven USD strength, reversing the dollar-down call
The repricing was already public (following a data release or Fed comment) and is fully in asset prices
Weak proxy/timing: a 2026-resolution market has little bearing on a 12-hour asset move
Move reverses as thin prediction-market liquidity mean-reverts
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
